rd.heading: Research and Development Expenses
rd.text:
For the three months ended September 30, 2026, research and development expenses were approximately $1,123,000. Specifically, during the three months ended September 30, 2026, our research and development costs consisted primarily of the following costs for each of our key research and development projects: (i) HT-001, approximately $979,000 related to manufacturing and clinical activities; and (ii) HT-VA approximately $35,000 related to preclinical studies. In addition to the foregoing, we also incurred fees of approximately $79,000 payable to members of our scientific advisory board for services, and $30,000 in licensing fees.

For the three months ended September 30, 2025, research and development expenses were approximately $1,633,000. Specifically, during the three months ended September 30, 2025, our research and development costs consisted primarily of the following costs for each of our key research and development projects: (i) HT-001, approximately $1,477,000 related to manufacturing and clinical activities; and (ii) HT-KIT, approximately $125,000 related to manufacturing and preclinical activities.

ga.heading: General and Administrative Expenses
ga.text:

During the three months ended September 30, 2026, the decrease in general and administrative expenses of approximately $1,041,000 was primarily attributed to (1) a decrease in compensation and related expenses of $973,000 primarily attributable to a decrease in stock-based compensation of approximately $968,000 in connection with the issuance of common stock for services during the three months ended September 30, 2025 as compared to none during the three months ended September 30, 2026, and a decrease in other compensation and related expenses of $5,000, (2) a decrease in professional and consulting expenses of approximately $137,000 which was primarily attributable to a decrease in legal and consulting fees of approximately $103,000, an increase in accounting fees of approximately $19,000, a decrease in stock-based professional fees of $43,000, and a decrease in directors’ fees of approximately $6,000, (3) a decrease in rent expense of $11,000 and (4) an increase in other general and administrative…

prov.text: In July 2025, the FASB issued ASU 2025-05, Measurement of Credit Losses for Accounts Receivable and Contract Assets (“ASU 2025-05”) amending ASC 326, Credit Losses, which provides a practical expedient for all entities in developing reasonable and supportable forecasts as part of estimating expected credit losses to assume that current conditions as of the balance sheet date do not change for the remaining life of the asset. The amendments in ASU 2025-05 are effective for annual reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2025, and interim reporting periods within those annual reporting periods, with early adoption permitted. The Company adopted ASU 2025-05 on January 1, 2026, and the adoption did not have a material impact on the Company’s unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements.

nonop.heading: Other Income (Expenses)
nonop.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, other expenses, net was approximately $150,000 and $25,000, respectively. During the three months ended September 30, 2026, we recorded an impairment loss on equity securities without readily determinable fair value of $150,000. During the three months ended September 30, 2025, we recorded a realized loss on crypto assets of approximately $25,000.

net.heading: Net Loss
net.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, we incurred a net loss of approximately $2,679,000, or $0.11 per common share (basic and diluted), and $4,106,000, or $0.30 per common share (basic and diluted), respectively.

ocf.heading: Cash Flows from Operating Activities
ocf.text:
For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net cash used in operating activities was approximately $8,804,000, which primarily resulted from a net loss of approximately $9,206,000, an increase in prepaid expenses and other current assets of approximately $319,000, a decrease in accounts payable and accrued expenses of approximately $273,000, offset by the add back of non-cash items such as approximately $44,000 of realized loss on crypto assets, $800,000 in stock-based compensation and professional fees, and an impairment loss on equity securities without readily determinable fair value of $150,000.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2025, net cash used in operating activities was approximately $7,654,000, which primarily resulted from a net loss of approximately $9,781,000, an increase in prepaid expenses and other current assets of approximately $357,000 and an increase in accounts payable and accrued expenses of approximately $196,000, offset by approximately $850,000 of non-cash research and development-acquired patent, $1,410,000 in stock-based compensation and professional fees, and unrealized loss on crypto assets of $25,000.

sbc.heading: Stock-based compensation
sbc.text:
The Company accounts for stock-based payment awards exchanged for services at the estimated grant date fair value of the award. Stock options issued under the Company’s long-term incentive plans are granted with an exercise price equal to no less than the market price of the Company’s stock at the date of grant and expire up to ten years from the date of grant. Options are generally issued fully vested. The Company accounts for forfeited awards as they occur.

The Company estimates the fair value of stock option grants using the Black-Scholes option pricing model and the assumptions used in calculating the fair value of stock-based awards represent management’s best estimates and involve inherent uncertainties and the application of management’s judgment.

Expected Term - The expected term of options represents the period that the Company’s stock-based awards are expected to be outstanding based on the simplified method, which is the half-life from vesting to the end of its contractual term.

Expected Volatility - The Company computes stock price volatility over expected terms based on its historical common stock trading prices.

intro.text: We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing new generation therapies for unmet medical needs. We are focused on developing (i) a topical formulation for treating side effects from drugs used for the treatment of cancer (HT-001); (ii) a treatment for mast-cell derived cancers and anaphylaxis (HT-KIT); and (iii) a treatment and/or prevention for Alzheimer’s or other neuroinflammatory diseases (HT-ALZ). We also have assets being developed for (i) atopic dermatitis (also known as eczema) (BioLexa); (ii) a treatment for asthma and allergies using inhalational administration (HT-004); and (iii) a treatment for obesity, and obesity-related diseases and conditions (HT-VA).

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
